## Which of these it touches

- [ ] Adds or changes an external action → which approval level, and who approves
- [ ] Adds a connector → the declaration from `connectors/contract/README.md`
- [ ] Changes what Zi remembers, or what crosses between contexts
- [ ] Changes a verification or publication path

## Confirm

- [ ] It stays generic — nothing specific to one organization, community or person
- [ ] It adds no autonomous external action
- [ ] Anything prompt-level would be described as prompt-level
